why: A Practice pick that keeps the CAMPAIGN identity. `campaignActive()` reads that identity and is what stops practice consuming, restoring, advancing or ending the run -- so an isolated look at level 2 starts writing the player's real campaign progress. Exactly the class the project's game rules name ('Practice/level-select state must not create or mutate a campaign run'), reintroduced at the new boundary rather than at the in-session handler that already had it. 1 of 412 -- 'practice lands on the picked level and leaves the run untouched', which is the only case that reads the run store after a pick.
